problem_summary: 9 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in Deepanjali Nagar between March 2019 and April 2021, spanning 3 calendar year(s). 22% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 36 pothole complaints.
39 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹24.7 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (exact_name join).

agency_attribution_note: 9 of 9 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.40). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, complaint_volume=0.30, unresolved_rate=0.22.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Deepanjali Nagar' matched to datameet243=163 via exact_name (overlap_confidence=0.649).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Deepanjali Nagar for the period 2019–2021.
Request inspection records for the 39 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
